import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX

def run(evs, trace=0):
    c = Case(PRIM_INDEX['allreduce'], 3, 0, 2, 1, 2, 0, trace)
    c.replay(evs)
    return c

full = [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p} for p in range(2) for r in range(4)]
c = run(full)
print('after data: packets', c.packets, 'txdata', c.state_list()[20], 'txack', c.state_list()[21], 'S', c.state_list()[6:10])
c = run(full + [{'op':'retry','rank':1}])
print('retry rank1: packets', c.packets, '(expect 19) txdata', c.state_list()[20], '(expect 10)')
c = run(full + [{'op':'ack','rank':1,'upto':1},{'op':'retry','rank':1}])
print('ack1 then retry: packets', c.packets, '(expect 16+1ack+1retrans=18) A', c.state_list()[10:14])
c = run(full + [{'op':'ack','rank':1,'upto':2},{'op':'retry','rank':1}])
print('ack2 then retry: packets', c.packets, '(expect 16+1 ack=17, no retrans)')
c = run(full + [{'op':'budget','n':2},{'op':'retry','rank':1}])
print('budget2 retry: packets', c.packets, 'fail', c.state_list()[29], '(ack + 1 retrans then fail)')
# retry on a nonreceiver for reduce
c = Case(PRIM_INDEX['reduce'], 3, 2, 2, 1, 2, 0, 0)
evs = [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p} for p in range(2) for r in range(4)]
c.replay(evs + [{'op':'retry','rank':0}])
st = c.state_list()
